dogecoin.text: Could we see an ETF on $DOGE ?
RECENTLY: Robinhood rewarded over 450,000 existing customers with $2.5 million in Bitcoin and Dogecoin on New Year's Eve to enhance customer loyalty.

JUST IN: Polymarket users have bet over $800,000 on whether Donald Trump will mention "Bitcoin," "Dogecoin," or related crypto terms during his Jan. 20 inauguration speech, with total trading volume exceeding $1.86 million.
